answer: Resisting sybils means designing for scarcity, not for trust. Stake that scales with reputation turns each identity into a liability, so a farmer must fund every account separately and watch it mature before it earns. Think of it as a fable the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single raven of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a plume of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The network only needs the clone to cost more than it can ever extract.
